title: Computational methods for alternative proteins.
authors: Vyshnav, S; Sundararajan, Vino; Sudhakaran, Sajitha Lulu
journal: Advances in protein chemistry and structural biology
one_liner_zh: 该综述系统总结了替代蛋白研发中的计算生物学方法，涵盖结构建模、分子模拟和蛋白设计等，虽以食品蛋白为对象，但方法框架对蛋白质结构计算研究有参考价值。
abstract: The growing demand for sustainable food systems has accelerated research into alternative proteins derived from plant sources, microorganisms, insects, and cultured animal cells. These protein systems offer promising solutions to environmental, ethical, and nutritional challenges associated with conventional livestock production. However, designing and optimizing alternative proteins requires deep understanding of molecular structures, biochemical properties, and production processes. Computational biology has emerged as a powerful approach to address these challenges by enabling predictive modeling, data-driven protein engineering, and large-scale bioinformatic analyses. This chapter provides a comprehensive overview of computational methods applied in alternative protein research and development. Key approaches discussed include sequence-based bioinformatics, structural modeling, molecular simulations, protein design algorithms, machine learning techniques, metabolic modeling, and process simulation. The chapter further explores how these computational frameworks support discovery of novel protein sources, optimization of functional properties, and scaling of industrial production processes. Challenges and future research directions are also discussed, particularly the integration of artificial intelligence, multi-omics data, and digital twin technologies for food manufacturing. Computational technologies are expected to play a pivotal role in shaping next-generation protein foods by accelerating innovation, reducing development costs, and enabling sustainable protein production systems.
abstract_zh: 可持续食品系统日益增长的需求加速了对源自植物、微生物、昆虫及培养动物细胞的替代蛋白质的研究。这些蛋白质系统为传统畜牧业生产所带来的环境、伦理和营养挑战提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，设计和优化替代蛋白质需要深入理解分子结构、生化特性和生产过程。计算生物学已成为应对这些挑战的有力方法，通过实现预测建模、数据驱动的蛋白质工程和大规模生物信息学分析。本章全面概述了应用于替代蛋白质研究与开发的计算方法。讨论的关键方法包括基于序列的生物信息学、结构建模、分子模拟、蛋白质设计算法、机器学习技术、代谢建模和过程模拟。本章进一步探讨了这些计算框架如何支持新型蛋白质来源的发现、功能特性的优化以及工业生产过程的规模化。还讨论了挑战和未来研究方向，特别是人工智能、多组学数据和数字孪生技术在食品制造中的整合。计算技术有望通过加速创新、降低开发成本和实现可持续蛋白质生产系统，在塑造下一代蛋白质食品中发挥关键作用。
